description: This file contains utility functions for filesystem operations, such as checking existence, creating directories, copying files/directories, and writing JSON data. It is a helper module for file manipulation tasks within a software project.

methods.name: doesDirExist
methods.description: Checks if the specified directory exists.

methods.name: doesFileExist
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists.

methods.name: ensureDirExists
methods.description: Creates the directory recursively if it does not exist.

methods.name: emptyExistingDir
methods.description: Deletes the contents of the directory if it exists.

methods.name: listDirFiles
methods.description: Lists the files in the specified directory.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes data as JSON and writes it to the specified path.

methods.name: copyRecursiveSync
methods.description: Recursively copies a directory and its contents.

methods.name: copyFileOrDir
methods.description: Copies a file or directory to a destination, optionally excluding files matching a glob pattern.
